properties.description: Whether this repository must publish the org ci-ok gate. 'required' is the default so a new repo is covered without anyone remembering; 'none' is an audited, visible exemption set only on repos with no code gate or on upstream mirrors/deployed forks.
Delivered customer project: finished and handed over. Every automation (Renovate, rulesets, rollouts, adoption scripts) skips repos with value delivered; changes only on a customer request.
